## My First Spark Test

I set up PySpark on my AWS EC2 instance and used this small example to make sure the environment was working correctly.

```{python}
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession

spark = (
    SparkSession.builder
    .master("local[2]")
    .appName("Naqiao AD688")
    .getOrCreate()
)

tools = [
    ("Python", "3.12"),
    ("PySpark", "4.0.4"),
    ("Quarto", "1.10")
]

df = spark.createDataFrame(tools, ["Tool", "Version"])
df.show()

spark.stop()
```

It is a simple test, but it confirms that Python and Spark can run correctly on my EC2 environment.
